title: Carried-binding refusal text: empty "()" for a repeated-words criterion with nothing compared, and only the first copy of duplicated words named
outcome: Two cosmetic fixes to the pre-spawn carried-binding refusal text in src/acceptance_evaluation_carried_binding.rs. The refusal itself is correct in both cases. (1) In the repeated-words branch (judged_count > 1), the compared list can be empty: for example judged ["X","X","Z"] with bindings 1 and 2, and current ["Z"]. The text then ends "...is left to keep that binding ()". Leave out the parenthetical when nothing is compared, as the words-gone branch already does, and add a test. (2) In the words-present branch (judged_count == 1), when the revision duplicated the judged words, only occurrences.first() is described. "the current criteria have it unbound" can then hide another copy that is bound, for example to a different kind or pin. Name every occurrence with its binding when there is more than one.
acceptance: When a judged binding whose words other judged criteria shared has no current criterion to compare, the carried-binding refusal names no empty list.
When the revision left a judged criterion's words on more than one current criterion and none keeps its binding, the refusal names each of those criteria with its current binding.
The existing carried-binding refusals and their tests are unchanged.
Focused tests covering the change, the full gate on the frozen input, and an independent Codex + Claude review pair with no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding cover the final input.
